title: Gaffney blocked Lockheed-to-Bigelow UFO material transfer

tellings.quote: fact, journalist George Knapp even testified to Congress saying that Gaffne was personally responsible for blocking the transfer of UFO materials from Loheed Martin to Bigalow Aerospace in 2008.

tellings.difference: Told by Knapp himself as a bare naming of Gaffney, with no date or details of the transfer.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Knapp naming the CIA's Glenn Gaffney before Congress as the man who blocked the Lockheed-to-Bigelow material transfer.

as_told.title: Glenn Gaffney of the CIA named as a UAP gatekeeper

plain: In 2008 a CIA official named Glenn Gaffney is said to have personally stopped UFO material from being handed from Lockheed Martin, a large defense company, to Bigelow Aerospace, a private space company. Michels relays this from the journalist George Knapp. He says Knapp "even testified to Congress" that Gaffney "was personally responsible for blocking the transfer of UFO materials" between the two companies. A guest named Dylan Borland speaks of the same congressional hearing and names the man too, simply as "Glenn Gaffney, CIA", without a date or any details of the transfer. If it is true, a CIA official stepped in to keep recovered material inside a defense company and away from a private company that was studying it.
